request.prompt:
Generate one exceptionally clean and polished Chinese Agent application screenshot for Client Reach, page "查询结果". Flat front-facing 16:9 full-screen desktop interface, no device frame, no perspective, crisp readable Chinese, designed at 1920x1080. This is a minimal AI research workspace, NOT a complex CRM dashboard.

EXACT SAME DESIGN SYSTEM: white #FFFFFF, near-white gray #F7F8FA, charcoal #20252C, muted gray #76808B, thin #E7EAEE borders, very pale blue #EAF3FD selection and #597FA7 quiet accents. Black / white / gray / light blue ONLY. No green/teal/purple/orange, no gradients. Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans-like Chinese at comfortable 14–16px scale, small headings, restrained typography, 10px card radius, no heavy shadow. Natural content-based heights and responsive wrapping; no huge KPI dashboard tiles.

SHELL: 176px pale-gray left sidebar with black square R symbol, "Client Reach", small "Agent 工作台". ONLY three navigation entries: "工作台", "查询结果", "设置". "查询结果" selected pale blue. Bottom tiny avatar "林", "本地工作空间". White 56px top header "查询结果", top right "公开研究快照 · 2026-10-08". DO NOT add procurement or relationship modules to the sidebar.

PAGE: modest charcoal heading "查询结果", subtitle "来自已完成的企业研究，可进入详情查看原文与分析". A simple search box "搜索已查询的企业" and 2 quiet outline filters "全部主体", "最近研究". No metrics strip. Small line above cards "4 条主体记录 · 包含集团汇总与实际采购主体". Do not call them four independent customers.

MAIN RESULT LAYOUT: FOUR CLIENT CARDS in a clean responsive wrapping row. Make 3 cards horizontally adjacent in the first row, fourth card flowing to a second row at left. Each card is roughly 420–470px wide at this design viewport, with natural varied height determined by its real content, aligned to a calm grid with 20px gutters. Long company names wrap properly, no clipped ellipsis. Entire card is visibly clickable, with a subtle arrow and footer "查看完整画像 →". Cards contain compact readable lists, not charts. Show normal hover/selected hint with a faint blue border on the sea/海能 card. Do not fill remaining space with unrelated widgets.

CARD 1: title "比亚迪股份有限公司", small monochrome company monogram "比", chips "集团汇总", "公开采购样本". Short description "新能源汽车、电子、电池及光伏". Natural list rows "采购样本 11 个独立项目", "公告记录 15 条", "实际买方 深圳锂电池 / 惠州电池", "需求涉及 材料制备、分析仪器、算力平台". Tiny note "结果按项目去重；不等于实际购买次数". Footer source "年报 · 原始采购公告", and link "查看完整画像 →".

CARD 2: title "海能未来技术集团股份有限公司", wrap into two lines if needed, monogram "海", chips "海能技术", "集团资料". One-line description "实验分析仪器制造". Lists "员工 566 人", second small line "2026-06-30 · 公司及控股子公司", "年营收 3.62 亿元 · 2025 年合并口径", "主要采购 结构件、电子元器件、功能部件", "公开关系 前五供应商 / 前五客户". A subtle low-height neutral strip "本轮未找到可核验的自身招采公告". Footer "2025 年报 · 2026 半年报 · 官网", link "查看完整画像 →". This card is slightly taller because its information requires it.

CARD 3: title "深圳市比亚迪锂电池有限公司", naturally wrapped; monogram "深", chips "实际采购主体", "比亚迪关联主体". Use exact description label "已取得采购方向" rather than inventing its full business scope. Lists "独立项目 7 项", "采购方向 材料分析 / 电池检测 / 算力平台", "已知需求 服务器 1 台、检测柜 5 台", "公告状态 截止已过，结果待核". Note "不继承集团人员与营收数据". Footer "原始采购公告", action "查看完整画像 →".

CARD 4: title "惠州比亚迪电池有限公司", monogram "惠", chips "实际采购主体", "比亚迪关联主体". Lists "独立项目 4 项", "采购方向 材料制备 / 工业废水暂存", "已知需求 气碎机 1 台、流化床 1 台", "公告状态 部分已有候选公示". Small note "候选结果不等于最终成交". Footer "原始采购公告 · 需求转载", action "查看完整画像 →".

A small understated empty-state reminder below the flowing cards "企业资料按来源展示，未披露字段在详情中保留缺口". Maintain real entity names, dates, numbers and report scope. Show data-rich yet concise clickable company cards. NO invented matching scores, no contact photos or personal phone numbers, no tender budget totals, no pipeline charts, no side detail panel crowding the card grid. This is a snapshot of existing research and a designed UI, not a promise of live verification.
